parsed.reason: "wait, two more coming" almost certainly means more texts are on the way, so the reply should be one short line acknowledging that. Instead Hale treats it as a puzzle and asks two questions ("Two more what?" and "Are two more kids…"). It adds the padding "I'm not sure what you mean", and floats an invented reading about extra kids at soccer or swim. That hands the parent work for a message that needed nothing done.
